target_customer: Retail and crypto native traders who want one app for news, copy trading, crypto, equities and pre-IPO exposure
problem: Investors lack easy access to pre-IPO and onchain markets and struggle to turn scattered social and financial news into trade ideas.
business_model: Trading platform earning from trading activity and leverage products (fee model not stated in sources)
product_category: Onchain trading and copy trading app

founders.name: Lihong Wang
founders.background_notes: Per YC page, ex options trader who traded single stock equity derivatives at three market makers. Education not listed.

founders.name: Bryan Reed
founders.background_notes: Per the YC founder Q&A. A search summary says Huawei HarmonyOS graphics engine, not confirmed on the page. Education not listed.

competitors.name: Injective pre-IPO perpetual markets
competitors.what: Onchain perpetuals on OpenAI, SpaceX and other private companies

technical_complexity.rationale: Non-custodial trading, wallet copy trading and perpetuals routing are standard onchain engineering, with an AI news feed added on top.

defensibility.rationale: Many onchain venues list similar products. Distribution and copy trading community are the only potential edges.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. Large platforms launched pre-IPO products in 2025 and 2026.

market_need_then: Strong retail appetite for pre-IPO exposure and onchain perpetuals in 2025, shown by launches from Injective, Robinhood and Hyperliquid venues.

branding.domain_note: Uses freeportmarkets.com, adds Markets to the real word

identity.visual_style: Fintech app style; site shows many bank and trading firm logos under Backed by, unclear relationship
identity.voice_and_tone: Copy Anyone. Track Everything. You miss all the shots you don't take.

branding.community_and_virality: Site claims 10,000 downloads and $200M+ traded (self reported); Alliance accelerator launch page

brand_strength.rationale: Freeport is a generic word shared with Freeport-McMoRan and prePO era products. Self reported usage only, no independent brand coverage.

pivots.from: Intelligent DeFi investment platform with factor based crypto portfolios (YC launch post)
pivots.to: Trading platform for pre-IPO, equities, crypto and perps with AI analysts and copy trading
pivots.why: Not stated; the current site and YC description differ from the launch post

outcome_analysis: Freeport Markets is a three person YC Fall 2025 company founded by ex market maker traders. It has already broadened from DeFi portfolios to a full trading app and self reports sizable volume. No exit or shutdown found. Regulatory exposure for leveraged crypto and pre-IPO products and strong competition from larger venues are the main risks.
notes: Aggregators report $500K (convertible note or pre-seed, October 2025) with YC, Inventum Ventures and Alliance, and VCBacked says $1.8M total. No company or press announcement, so unverified and not recorded as rounds. Caplight's Freeport Technologies, LLC and prePO are different or unconfirmed entities. Usage figures and the investor and media logos on the site are self reported.
